results.title: Inflation hits a new high as Americans’ top issue

results.content:
YouGov and the Economist have been regularly tracking views on US presidents by asking voters whether they approve or disapprove of the job the leader is doing.

In his first term, Trump was into net negative territory effectively from the moment he took office. President Biden was in the negatives within seven months. [...] But in his second term, Trump has plummeted. A week out from polling day, the Economist recorded a net approval rating of -27, with 34 per cent of voters approving of the job he's doing and 61 per cent disapproving.

That is a lower net approval rating than any other president has recorded just before their midterm elections since World War II.
